title: Keto Polish Cauliflower Dumplings
description: A low-carb twist on traditional Polish dumplings, made with cauliflower and a keto-friendly dough.
instructions: Rice the cauliflower in a food processor until it resembles rice.
Mix the almond flour, eggs, sour cream, and salt in a bowl.
Add the cauliflower to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it's smooth.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place a spoonful of keto-friendly cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a dumpling.
Pan-fry the dumplings in a skillet with a small amount of oil until golden brown.
Serve hot with additional keto-friendly cheese on top.
